# Nika — Complete Reference for LLM Training

> Semantic YAML workflow engine for AI tasks. Orchestrate LLMs, APIs, shell commands, and MCP tools with declarative DAG workflows.
> Schema: `nika/workflow@0.12` | Extension: `.nika.yaml` | Version: 0.52.0

## Key Features

- 5 semantic verbs: infer, exec, fetch, invoke, agent
- 9 LLM providers: Anthropic, OpenAI, Mistral, Groq, DeepSeek, Gemini, xAI, native (local GGUF), mock
- Provider fallback chains: `provider: [groq, claude, openai]`
- Custom OpenAI-compatible endpoints via `base_url`
- 8 agent presets: think, lite, search, vision, judge, coder, summary, creative
- Multi-workflow orchestration (P-ORCHESTRATE) via `goal:` + `orchestrate:`
- 30+ builtin tools (nika:* prefix)
- 9 fetch extract modes
- 4-layer structured output with JSON schema enforcement + auto-repair
- Vision/multimodal via CAS hashes
- Agent guardrails: length, schema, regex, LLM judge
- 31 pipe transforms
- Record persistence to NDJSON
- Context budget with proportional truncation + LLM compression
- Retry on all verbs with exponential backoff

---

## Workflow Structure

```yaml
schema: nika/workflow@0.12        # Required. Always @0.12
workflow: my-workflow              # Optional. Defaults to filename
description: "What this does"     # Optional
provider: anthropic                # Default provider (or array for fallback)
model: claude-sonnet-4-20250514   # Default model

inputs:                            # Workflow parameters with defaults
  topic: "AI workflow engines"

context:                           # File bindings loaded at boot
  files:
    readme: ./README.md            # Available as {{context.readme}}

include:                           # Include partial workflows (tasks merged into DAG)
  - path: ./partials/setup.nika.yaml
    prefix: setup_

goal: "High-level objective"       # P-ORCHESTRATE: orchestrator intent (v0.52+)
orchestrate:                       # Multi-workflow orchestration (v0.52+)
  workflows:
    - name: sub_flow
      path: ./sub.nika.yaml
  round_strategy: sequential

mcp:                               # MCP server definitions
  server-name:
    command: npx
    args: ["-y", "@modelcontextprotocol/server-name"]
    env:
      API_KEY: $env.API_KEY

agents:                            # Reusable agent definitions
  researcher:
    system: "You are a research assistant"
    tools: [web_search, read_file]
    max_turns: 10

skills:                            # Prompt augmentation files
  writing: ./skills/writing-style.md

artifacts:                         # Global output configuration
  dir: ./output
  format: markdown                 # text | json | yaml | markdown | binary
  mode: overwrite                  # overwrite | append | unique | fail
  manifest: true                   # Write artifacts.json index

tasks: []                          # Required. Task list
```

---

## 5 Verbs — Each task uses exactly one

### infer: — LLM Generation

```yaml
- id: generate
  infer:
    prompt: "Write about {{inputs.topic}}"  # Required (unless content:)
    system: "You are a poet"                # System prompt
    temperature: 0.7                        # 0.0-2.0
    max_tokens: 500                         # Output limit
    extended_thinking: true                 # Claude extended thinking
    thinking_budget: 10000                  # Thinking tokens
    response_format: json                   # text | json | markdown
    content:                                # Vision/multimodal (v0.34+)
      - type: image
        source: "{{with.photo_hash}}"       # CAS hash, NOT file path
        detail: high                        # high | low | auto
      - type: text
        text: "Describe this image"
    guardrails:
      - type: length
        min_words: 50
        max_words: 200
        on_failure: retry                   # retry | escalate | fail
```

Shorthand: `infer: "Your prompt here"`

### exec: — Shell Command

```yaml
- id: build
  exec:
    command: "npm run build"
    shell: true                             # Run via sh -c (default: false)
    cwd: ./frontend                         # Working directory
    env:                                    # Environment variables
      NODE_ENV: production
    timeout: 30                             # Seconds (NOT milliseconds)
```

Shorthand: `exec: "echo hello"` (shell: false by default)

### fetch: — HTTP Request

```yaml
- id: get_data
  fetch:
    url: "https://api.example.com/data"
    method: POST                            # GET | POST | PUT | DELETE | PATCH
    headers:
      Authorization: "Bearer {{with.token}}"
    json:                                   # JSON body (auto-serialized)
      query: "{{with.search_term}}"
    body: "raw string body"                 # Alternative to json:
    extract: markdown                       # Post-processing mode (see below)
    selector: "article.main"               # CSS selector or JSONPath expr
    response: full                          # full | binary | (default: raw body)
    follow_redirects: true                  # Default: true
    timeout: 30                             # Seconds
```

Shorthand: `fetch: "https://example.com"`

#### 9 Extract Modes
| Mode | Description | selector: |
|------|-------------|-----------|
| `markdown` | HTML to clean Markdown | No |
| `article` | Main article content (Readability) | No |
| `text` | Visible text, optionally filtered | Optional (CSS) |
| `selector` | Raw HTML matching elements | Required (CSS) |
| `metadata` | OG, Twitter Cards, JSON-LD, SEO | No |
| `links` | Link classification (internal/external) | No |
| `jsonpath` | JSONPath query on JSON responses | Required (JSONPath) |
| `feed` | RSS/Atom/JSON Feed parsing | No |
| `llm_txt` | AI content discovery (/.well-known/llm.txt) | No |

#### Response Modes
- `full` — JSON: `{ status, headers, body, final_url }`
- `binary` — Store raw bytes in CAS, return hash for media pipeline
- (default) — Raw body text

### invoke: — MCP Tool Call

```yaml
- id: search
  invoke:
    tool: "server::tool_name"               # server::tool (double colon)
    params:                                  # Tool parameters
      query: "{{with.search_term}}"
    mcp: server-name                        # Explicit server (if not in tool name)
    resource: "resource://uri"              # Alternative to tool:
    timeout: 30
```

Shorthand: `invoke: "nika:dimensions"`

#### 30+ Builtin nika:* Tools (no MCP needed)
- **Always-on**: nika:import, nika:dimensions, nika:thumbhash, nika:dominant_color, nika:pipeline
- **Media**: nika:thumbnail, nika:convert, nika:strip, nika:metadata, nika:optimize, nika:svg_render
- **Opt-in**: nika:phash, nika:compare, nika:pdf_extract, nika:chart, nika:provenance, nika:verify, nika:qr_validate, nika:quality, nika:html_to_md, nika:css_select, nika:extract_metadata, nika:extract_links, nika:readability
- **Introspection**: nika:cost, nika:records, nika:dag_info, nika:task_status, nika:threads, nika:orchestrate
- **Core**: nika:sleep, nika:log, nika:emit, nika:assert, nika:prompt, nika:run, nika:complete
- **File**: nika:read, nika:write, nika:edit, nika:glob, nika:grep

### agent: — Multi-Turn Autonomous Loop

```yaml
- id: research
  agent:
    prompt: "Research {{with.topic}}"        # Required
    system: "You are a researcher"           # Agent persona
    tools: [web_search, read_file]           # Available tools
    mcp: [novanet, github]                   # MCP servers to expose
    max_turns: 20                            # Max iterations
    max_tokens: 4096                         # Tokens per response
    token_budget: 100000                     # Total token budget
    temperature: 0.7
    extended_thinking: true                  # Claude thinking
    thinking_budget: 10000
    from: researcher                         # Reference agents: definition
    skills: [writing]                        # Inject skills
    tool_choice: auto                        # auto | required | none
    scope: full                              # full | minimal | debug
    depth_limit: 3                           # Max spawn_agent recursion
    stop_sequences: ["DONE"]
    guardrails:
      - type: length
        max_words: 500
        on_failure: retry
      - type: schema
        json_schema: { type: object, required: [findings] }
        on_failure: escalate
      - type: regex
        pattern: "^## (Findings|Summary)"
        on_failure: retry
    completion:
      mode: explicit                         # explicit | natural | pattern
    limits:
      max_cost_usd: 2.0
      max_duration_secs: 120
```

Note: `agent: "think"` (scalar string) = **preset reference**, NOT the agent verb.

#### 8 Agent Presets (v0.51+)
| Preset | Purpose |
|--------|---------|
| `think` | Extended thinking for deep reasoning |
| `lite` | Fast responses, low token budget |
| `search` | Web research with tool access |
| `vision` | Image analysis |
| `judge` | Fact-checking and evaluation |
| `coder` | Code generation |
| `summary` | Text synthesis |
| `creative` | Creative generation |

Usage: `from: think` on any agent task.

---

## Task-Level Fields (all verbs)

```yaml
- id: my-task                       # Required. Unique within workflow
  description: "What this does"     # Optional

  # Provider/model override
  provider: openai                  # Override (or array: [openai, claude] for fallback)
  model: gpt-4o                     # Or slash syntax: model: groq/llama-3.3-70b
  preset: think                     # Agent preset reference (v0.51+)

  # Data flow
  with:                             # Bind data from other tasks
    data: $other_task               # $ prefix = task reference
    clean: $source | trim | upper   # Pipe transforms
    temp: $api.data.temp ?? 20      # JSONPath + ?? fallback
    key: $env.API_KEY               # Environment variable
  depends_on: [task_a, task_b]      # Pure ordering (no data flow)

  # Iteration
  for_each: "$list_task"            # Array to iterate (or inline array)
  as: item                          # Loop variable (default: "item")
  concurrency: 5                    # Max parallel (default: 1 = sequential)
  fail_fast: true                   # Stop on first error (default: true)
  # Access index: {{with.for_each_index}} (v0.52+)

  # Recording & context (v0.51+)
  record: true                      # Output recording to NDJSON
  context_budget: 50000             # Token budget for bindings

  # Routing (v0.50+)
  routing:
    fallback: [openai, claude]
    strategy: cost                  # cost | latency | availability

  # Resilience (works on ALL verbs)
  retry:
    max_attempts: 3
    delay_ms: 1000
    backoff: 2.0                    # Exponential multiplier

  # Structured output (JSON schema enforcement)
  structured:
    schema:                         # Inline or file path: ./schemas/output.json
      type: object
      properties:
        name: { type: string }
        score: { type: number }
      required: [name]
    enable_repair: true             # LLM auto-repair on violation
    max_retries: 3                  # Retry attempts for schema validation
    repair_model: claude-haiku-4-5  # Cheaper model for repair passes

  # Artifact persistence
  artifact:
    path: result.json
    format: json                    # text | json | yaml | markdown | binary
    source: raw_data                # Save upstream binding (not task output)

  # Logging
  log: debug                        # Override workflow log level
```

---

## Data Flow & Templates

### with: Bindings

```yaml
with:
  data: $other_task                 # Simple task reference
  nested: $task.field.subfield      # JSONPath access
  safe: $task.value ?? "default"    # Fallback for null
  clean: $source | trim | upper     # Pipe transforms
  combined: $article.title | trim | default("Untitled")  # Combined
  key: $env.API_KEY                 # Environment variable
```

Rules:
- `$` prefix required for task references
- `$env.VAR` reads environment variables
- `??` provides fallback when path is null
- `|` chains transforms
- for_each output is ALWAYS an array: use `$results | first` or `$results[0].field`

### Template Syntax

| Pattern | Source |
|---------|--------|
| `{{with.alias}}` | Bound task output |
| `{{with.alias.field.nested}}` | Nested field access |
| `{{inputs.name}}` | Workflow input parameter |
| `{{context.readme}}` | Context file content |
| `{{with.item}}` | Current for_each item |
| `{{with.for_each_index}}` | Loop iteration index (v0.52+) |

### 31 Pipe Transforms

| Category | Transforms |
|----------|------------|
| String | `upper`, `lower`, `trim`, `trim_start`, `trim_end`, `length`, `to_string` |
| Collection | `first`, `last`, `first(N)`, `last(N)`, `flatten`, `reverse`, `sort`, `unique`, `compact`, `keys`, `values` |
| Numeric | `to_number`, `round(N)`, `abs`, `ceil`, `floor` |
| Type | `to_bool`, `to_json`, `parse_json`, `type_of` |
| Parametric | `join(",")`, `split(",")`, `default("fallback")` |
| System | `shell` (shell-escape for safe interpolation) |

Null safety: `{{with.x | default("none") | upper}}`

---

## Providers

| Provider | Aliases | Env Var | Notable Models |
|----------|---------|---------|----------------|
| `anthropic` | `claude` | `ANTHROPIC_API_KEY` | claude-opus-4-20250514, claude-sonnet-4-20250514, claude-haiku-4-5 |
| `openai` | `gpt` | `OPENAI_API_KEY` | gpt-4o, gpt-4.1, o3, o4-mini |
| `mistral` | -- | `MISTRAL_API_KEY` | mistral-large-latest, mistral-small-latest |
| `groq` | -- | `GROQ_API_KEY` | llama-3.3-70b-versatile, mixtral-8x7b-32768 |
| `deepseek` | `deep-seek` | `DEEPSEEK_API_KEY` | deepseek-chat, deepseek-reasoner |
| `gemini` | `google` | `GEMINI_API_KEY` | gemini-2.5-pro, gemini-2.5-flash |
| `xai` | `grok` | `XAI_API_KEY` | grok-3 |
| `native` | `local` | -- | Local GGUF via mistral.rs (text only, no vision) |
| `mock` | -- | -- | Deterministic test responses, no API calls |

Provider fallback: `provider: [groq, claude, openai]` — auto-retry on failure.
Custom endpoints: `base_url: "http://localhost:8000/v1"` — OpenAI-compatible servers.

---

## DAG Patterns

### Sequential Chain
```yaml
tasks:
  - id: fetch
    fetch: { url: "https://api.example.com/data" }
  - id: process
    depends_on: [fetch]
    with: { data: $fetch }
    infer: "Process: {{with.data}}"
```

### Diamond
```yaml
tasks:
  - id: source
    exec: "echo 'data'"
  - id: left
    with: { d: $source }
    infer: "Left: {{with.d}}"
  - id: right
    with: { d: $source }
    infer: "Right: {{with.d}}"
  - id: merge
    with: { l: $left, r: $right }
    infer: "Merge: {{with.l}} + {{with.r}}"
```

### Fan-Out / Fan-In
```yaml
tasks:
  - id: get_urls
    infer: "List 5 URLs about {{inputs.topic}}"
    structured:
      schema:
        type: object
        properties:
          urls: { type: array, items: { type: string } }

  - id: scrape_all
    for_each: "$get_urls.urls"
    as: url
    concurrency: 5
    fetch:
      url: "{{with.url}}"
      extract: article

  - id: synthesize
    with: { articles: $scrape_all }
    infer: "Synthesize: {{with.articles | join('\n---\n')}}"
```

### Multi-Provider Research
```yaml
tasks:
  - id: research_web
    provider: xai
    model: grok-3
    infer: "Find stories about {{inputs.topic}}"

  - id: research_academic
    provider: anthropic
    infer: "Academic research on {{inputs.topic}}"

  - id: merge
    depends_on: [research_web, research_academic]
    with: { web: $research_web, academic: $research_academic }
    infer: "Synthesize: {{with.web}} + {{with.academic}}"
```

---

## Structured Output — 5-Layer Defense

```yaml
- id: extract
  infer:
    prompt: "Tell me about Alice, 30, Rust and Python developer"  # NATURAL prompt
  structured:
    schema:
      type: object
      properties:
        name: { type: string }
        age: { type: number, minimum: 0 }
        skills: { type: array, items: { type: string }, minItems: 1 }
      required: [name, age, skills]
    enable_repair: true
    max_retries: 3
```

CRITICAL: The prompt MUST be natural language. NEVER mention JSON or the schema in the prompt.
The 4 layers handle extraction: L0 tool injection → L2 extract+validate → L3 retry → L4 LLM repair.

---

## Security

- API keys: env vars only (`$env.API_KEY`). Never hardcode in YAML.
- `fetch:` validates URLs against SSRF (private IP ranges blocked).
- `exec:` blocklist: `rm -rf /`, `sudo`, `$()`, backticks (NIKA-053).
- `shell: true` enables shell features — only use when pipes/redirects needed.
- Never commit `.nika/traces/` to git.

---

## Common Mistakes

| Wrong | Right | Why |
|-------|-------|-----|
| `timeout: 30000` (ms) | `timeout: 30` | Always seconds |
| `data: other_task` | `data: $other_task` | $ prefix required |
| `{{data}}` | `{{with.data}}` | Always with. prefix |
| `{{item}}` in for_each | `{{with.item}}` | Loop var uses with. prefix |
| `retry: 3` | `retry: { max_attempts: 3 }` | Object, not integer |
| `.yaml` extension | `.nika.yaml` | Required extension |
| `shell: bash` | `shell: true` | Boolean, not shell name |
| Missing `schema:` | `schema: "nika/workflow@0.12"` | Required first line |
| `depends_on: task_id` | `depends_on: [task_id]` | Always array |
| `tool: "server/tool"` | `tool: "server::tool"` | Double colon |
| `retry:` inside `invoke:` | `retry:` at task level | Task-level, not verb-level |
| `body: {...}` for JSON | `json: {...}` | json: auto-serializes |
| `{{with.results.field}}` after for_each | `{{with.results[0].field}}` | for_each = array |
| `provider: native` for vision | Use cloud provider | GGUF is text-only |
| `model:` inside `infer:` | `model:` at task level | Model is task-level |

---

## CLI Commands

```bash
# Workflows
nika run workflow.nika.yaml        # Execute workflow
nika run --provider mock           # Test without API calls
nika run --dry-run                 # Validate + cost estimate
nika check workflow.nika.yaml      # Validate syntax + DAG
nika check --strict                # + test MCP connections
nika new my-flow --verb infer      # Create new workflow

# Direct verbs (no YAML needed)
nika infer "Explain quantum computing"
nika fetch https://blog.com --extract article
nika invoke nika:dimensions photo.jpg
nika agent "Research AI" --turns 5

# Models & providers
nika model list                    # Cloud models + pricing
nika model info claude-sonnet-4-6  # Model details
nika provider list                 # API key status
nika provider set anthropic        # Store key in keychain
nika bench                         # Provider benchmarking

# System
nika ui                            # Terminal UI
nika init                          # Project setup
nika init --course                 # 12-level learning course
nika doctor --fix                  # System health + auto-repair
nika setup                         # API key wizard
nika switch dev|release            # Channel management
nika daemon status                 # Background daemon (Unix)
```
